notes: Consumables now state a once-per-Short-Rest benefit limit per specific product, preventing duplicate copies from being spammed while keeping the items consumable; Corvus Neural Adaptation Kit remains a one-time permanent treatment.
Firearm cards are now fully player-facing: removed FINAL GUN, REVIEW STATUS, and GM REVIEW NOTES development metadata while preserving manufacturer doctrine and existing special systems.
Melee cards no longer expose a CUSTOM EFFECT yes/no development field; they show damage type instead and still surface actual iconic effects when present.
Unique weapon cards now describe their real high-tier rare-shop availability instead of claiming they never appear in Market stock.
Market stock patch 1.4.1 runs weapon pricing/rarity migration before stock reset or first roll so tier and rarity gating are correct immediately.
Gun passive-effect design is intentionally deferred to the dedicated final firearm-passive pass; current manufacturer traits and established special effects remain preserved.
